subject.title: [Bug]: Telegram provider intermittently stalls despite stable direct Bot API connectivity

question: Is the remaining Telegram SOCKS5 stall ready for a concrete repair path, or should maintainers wait for current-release live proxy diagnostics?
rationale: Current source keeps the plausible explicit proxy gap alive, but the intermittent live failure has not been reproduced on current main and proxy behavior is compatibility-sensitive.

options.title: Wait for live diagnostics
options.body: Keep the issue open and ask for redacted current-release Telegram SOCKS5 getMe/sendMessage proof from the affected service environment before choosing a fix.

options.title: Sponsor the proxy repair
options.body: Have a maintainer adopt or replace the focused proxy transport PR after deciding the intended explicit/env proxy behavior and validation scope.

recommendation.title: Wait for live diagnostics
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open and ask for redacted current-release Telegram SOCKS5 getMe/sendMessage proof from the affected service environment before choosing a fix.

likelyOwner.reason: The central unresolved decision is in shared Undici proxy helper behavior, and history ties steipete to that helper's current design.
